answer: Every epoch a sampler pulls 5 percent of identities for audit, and any attempt to link two accounts resets both scores to zero, so a farm reusing one wallet loses the whole batch at once. No identity audits its own recruit, which means a farm's own accounts cannot clear each other and it waits on strangers with no reason to sign. The only signal those strangers get is a display name. You get what you pay for: a meadow of fresh accounts with no cedar of history behind them.
